title: A family smaller than the cofinality is bounded below an ordinal
statement: Let $\delta$ be an ordinal, viewed as a well-ordered set (a total order in which every nonempty subset has a least element, as in [lem-weil-pbc-transfinite-recursion]), and let $I$ be a set. Define $\operatorname{cf}(\delta)$ to be the least cardinality of a subset $T\subseteq\delta$ such that for every $\gamma<\delta$ some $t\in T$ satisfies $\gamma\leq t$. Let $(a_i)_{i\in I}$ be ordinals with $a_i<\delta$ for every $i\in I$. If $|I|<\operatorname{cf}(\delta)$, then $\sup_{i\in I}a_i<\delta$, where the supremum of an empty family is $0$.
